answer: The jade is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the garden. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The sonnet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
